title: What's new in v2.12.0
summary: Find the flaky links UniFi doesn't show you

steps.title: LAN Health
steps.listLabel: Find the flaky links UniFi doesn't show you
steps.body:
**LAN Health** scores every link between your UniFi devices and every wired port, and catches what UniFi Network never surfaces: links that drop for a few seconds, errors on one end, storms, and backhauls going soft.

Click **View Link** on a finding to see both ends, every source, and when it started.

steps.title: Device Restart
steps.listLabel: Restart a device now, at a set time, or when your network is quiet
steps.body:
The **Restart** button in the corner of a **Device Status** card restarts that device now, at a time you choose, or at its next quiet hour, measured from its own traffic and everything below it.

Restarts close together run once each, top of the network first, and wait out firmware upgrades. A device powered from a switch port can be power-cycled instead.
